name: Ruou Bau Da
summary: A rice spirit Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định places at Cù Lâm, Nhơn Lộc, An Nhơn, and calls stronger than 50 degrees. Cổng du lịch Quy Nhơn – Bình Định says the seafood at Hòn Khô is drunk with it.
origin: Thôn Cù Lâm, xã Nhơn Lộc, thị xã An Nhơn. The city tourism introduction also names it. The village is not a beach bar.
taste: The provincial portal says the first of the run is clear, hot, and sharp, sweet in the throat after, and that a heavy night does not leave a morning headache. It is also poured at weddings, funerals, and death anniversaries.
howToEat: The provincial portal says pour from a height into a small cup so it foams without spilling. Drink it with the Hòn Khô seafood, on the tourism portal's line.
